documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Standalone And Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30 2026.

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported a strong performance in the second half of the financial year 2026, with consolidated revenue reaching Rs. 188 crores, up 35% over the first half. The water technologies segment remains the largest business unit, contributing 87% of the total revenue. While the company is starting the new financial year with a strong order book, it is facing margin pressures due to rising metal-based raw material costs and geopolitical challenges. Management is maintaining a tight credit policy across its business units and expects volume-driven growth to continue.

guidance.claim: The company expects around 15% to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in the first quarter of the year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: The company expects volume growth in water chemicals to be roughly around 10% in the first quarter of the year.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

guidance.claim: The company is trying to ensure plans are in place to reach an aspirational target of 1000 crore.
guidance.quote: So 1000 crore is, yes, it is an aspiratory number. We are trying to ensure that we have plans in place to get to that number.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

demand_outlook.claim: The company's revenue outlook continues to remain positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing a pickup in the AHU fin cleaning and drinking water disinfection segment, driven by data centers and commercial buildings.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing some pickup in this segment, especially driven by a lot of data centers and commercial buildings having significantly large AHUs. in place.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a robust enquiry pipeline for water technologies.
Management observed steady revenue growth with a tight credit policy in construction chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: Steady revenue growth with tight credit policy

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that customer base increases were seen on a year-on-year basis in construction chemicals.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer base increases seen on a Y-o-Y basis

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that construction chemicals demand was 18% stronger.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's capital expenditure of 21 crores was primarily due to the demerger effect, including office building improvements and renovation.
capex_expansion.quote: And of course, the office building, the improvements that we've done and the The entire renovation of the office building to house our teams, so that has taken up, but twenty-one crores, whole demerger, yeah, P.P.E. which has come into our books, so this is the demerger effect.

capex_expansion.claim: The company intends to deploy some of its funds for network growth and geographical expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is growing its team in Thailand, where it has added new accounts and customers.
capex_expansion.quote: In Thailand, we've been able to add new accounts, new customers. So that's a segment where we also are growing our team.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹90.76 lakhs to install a 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at its Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Most of the margin improvements were driven by lower costs.
margins_costs.quote: Most of the margin improvements are, of course, on lower costs.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is currently facing some challenges.
margins_costs.quote: However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs began to increase starting from late February and March.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March.

margins_costs.claim: It typically takes the company about a couple of quarters to fully pass on increased costs to customers.
margins_costs.quote: But what happens is that when costs increase, It takes us about a couple quarters to pass them on fully.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced a 3% impact on its margins in the immediate month due to volatile costs.
margins_costs.quote: But in the immediate month, we saw about a 3% impact on our margins due to these haywire costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that material costs increased due to war impact, with some volatility in metal compounds.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

orders_capacity.claim: The company is starting the financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has contracts for chemicals running until late in the financial year before renewal, in addition to its equipment systems order book.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment systems are of course on the order book we have, but even the chemicals we have contracts running till late in this financial year before they come up for renewal.

orders_capacity.claim: The water business unit is entering the period with a strong order book for both chemicals and equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: Water BU, we are entering this, as I mentioned earlier, with a strong order book for chemicals as well as for the equipment.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported a strong order book for specialty chemicals.
orders_capacity.quote: Strong order book for specialty chemicals

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that equipment and systems deliveries are on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted that water technologies has a 36% stronger order book.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a tight credit policy with day sales outstanding for construction chemicals at around 88 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The distribution business maintains a tight credit policy with day sales outstanding at roughly 80 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: So here also we are maintaining a tight credit policy with days sales outstanding at 80 days, roughly as on 31st of March 2026

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no plans for additional plant setup or further deployment of its cash balance beyond current year capex, as it is preparing for the worst eventualities.
capital_allocation.quote: No, no, no, nothing to that extent. But currently we are preparing for the worst eventualities.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share of ₹5 face value for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The period following the declaration of war was very challenging.
risks_headwinds.quote: And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faced challenges in delivering customer service and maintaining product flow because public sector units, which make up about 30% of the water business, did not accept force majeure until the government declared it.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago. And hence, we had a challenging time delivering good customer service and maintaining product flow to other customers as well as them.

risks_headwinds.claim: The second quarter of the first half was slow due to the monsoon, though performance picked up in the third and fourth quarters.
risks_headwinds.quote: In first half year, our quarter two was slow on account of monsoon, but yes, quarter three and quarter four picked up.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed out that prolonged monsoon affected construction chemicals activity, which picked up post monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

management_commitments.claim: The company expects around 15% to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in the first quarter of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects volume growth in water chemicals to be roughly around 10% in the first quarter of the year.
management_commitments.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to consolidate its presence in the sealants segment through polysulfide and PU sealants.
management_commitments.quote: Sealants, we are seeing a significant growth and we intend to consolidate our presence in that segment through our polysulfide and PU sealants.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to deploy some of its cash balance in network growth and geographical expansion.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that post-demerger compliances are on track and records are being updated.
management_commitments.quote: Post demerger compliances are on track, records being updated

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
